answer: In a grove of AI trading agents, every identity must lock 100 jade tokens for 30 days before bidding for work. At each market pulse, the system checks signed commitments; two conflicting commitments for the same job trigger forfeiture of that identity’s stake. Creating names is free, but activating 1,000 fake agents ties up 100,000 tokens, and using them to equivocate burns collateral. The defense makes influence costly without pretending identities are unique.
